in_hebrew.name: Ladonna
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Lady, princes, or mistress
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Ladonna הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek name Ladonis, meaning 'lady' or 'mistress'. In Greek mythology, the name was associated with the god Pan and the nymphs of his court. In Christian tradition, the name Ladonna is a feminine form of the biblical Ladon, who was a Levite and the father of Abihud.
